question: In October 2022, Justice ______ has been appointed as the presiding officer of the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) tribunal by the government of India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dinesh Kumar**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Justice **Dinesh Kumar** has been appointed as the presiding officer of the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) tribunal by the government of India in October 2022.
 
• The Unlawful Activities (Prevention) tribunal is constituted to adjudicate whether there is sufficient cause for declaring an association unlawful.
 
• The appointment of the presiding officer is crucial for the tribunal's functioning and the fair administration of justice.
 
• Justice Dinesh Kumar brings with him a wealth of experience and expertise in the legal field.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act was enacted in 1967 to provide for the effective prevention of certain unlawful activities of individuals and associations.
 
• The Act aims to provide powers to the central government to deal with activities directed against the integrity and sovereignty of India.
 
• It has been amended several times to enhance its scope and effectiveness in combating terrorism and related activities.
 
• The tribunal plays a vital role in ensuring that the provisions of the Act are applied judiciously and fairly.
